messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team is taking over the product catalog from the Cinder team. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- The product catalog is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-12-19, having moved from Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
    earlier: Cinder owns the product catalog. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- Dashboards and alerts for the product catalog are being repointed as of the 2025-12-19 handover. [valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
- The indexer relies on the product catalog for product documents, so if the product catalog is down the indexer is down. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- The image resizer is a hard dependency of the product catalog. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- The product catalog calls the image resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- On 2026-06-04 the Boreal team noticed that the product catalog's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-06-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-06-04]
- The image resizer is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-11-26, having moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
    earlier: The image resizer is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-20. [valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-11-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: The Dune team owns the image resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team is taking over the event bus from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
- As of 2025-12-25, the Atlas team is located on the second floor. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- The billing API is owned by the Ember team as of 2026-01-12, having moved from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-12-billing-api]
- As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder instead of the Atlas team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- The reporting service is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-12-05, having moved from the Dune team. [decision; valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
    earlier: The reporting service is owned by the Dune team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-12-05; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table. [decision; valid 2025-04-17 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-17]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is the primary on-call for the Ember team, taking over from Diego. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Diego is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- On 2025-12-18 the Atlas team decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every product catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. [decision; valid 2025-12-18 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-18]
- As of 2025-07-17, the ledger service remains owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-07-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-17]
- On 2026-03-20 the Boreal team noticed that the product catalog's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-03-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-20-2]
- As of 2025-10-13, ownership of the ledger service transferred to Cinder from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
